title: Garsa Fwip
description: A Twi'lek, Garsha Fwip owned the Sanctuary cantina. Located in Mos Espa on Tatooine, the cantina featured gambling and live music. After Boba Fett overthrew Bib Fortuna, he met with Fwip to guarantee the continuity of her business. She became a reliable source of information. Unfortunately, Fwip died when the Pyke Syndicated bombed Sanctuary.
